instruction: What value does this project give to `retry_limit`? Search the whole project folder, including data/, and write just the number to answer.txt.
setup: mkdir -p data && python3 -c "import sys; l='2024-05-01T12:00:00Z INFO worker-%d handled request id=%08d status=200 bytes=512\n'; f=open('data/events.log','w'); [f.write(l % (i % 8, i)) for i in range(600000)]" && truncate -s 2G data/disk.img
